$comment: Machine-readable dependency licence inventory for StackBraid. Source of truth for scripts/check-dependency-licenses.mjs. Human-readable narrative in docs/DEPENDENCIES.md. Update both together — see docs/DEPENDENCIES.md '# Keeping this current'.

rule.compiled-into-user-code: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC, 0BSD, Python-2.0 only
rule.separate-process: Copyleft acceptable — it never reaches the user's code
rule.build-tooling: Invoked via CLI/codegen at build or test time, never linked into or shipped inside the user's compiled application — copyleft acceptable on the same basis as separate-process
rule.ci-only: Installed by a CI workflow to check the repository itself, never installed on an end user's machine or shipped in a release artifact — copyleft acceptable, invoked via CLI only, never linked
